subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the unique session-replay and fail-closed authorization work be split onto current main, or should owners repair and re-prove this conflicted aggregate?
rationale: Both paths can preserve the useful work, but the aggregate duplicates landed mobile code and combines compatibility, session-state, and authorization changes; repository evidence cannot determine the preferred landing vehicle without owner intent.

options.title: Split unique remainder
options.body: Create narrow current-main PRs for ancestor-session replay and fail-closed authorization while dropping duplicated mobile and generated gate churn.

options.title: Repair aggregate
options.body: Resolve all eight conflicts against current main, retain only non-duplicated behavior, and re-prove the combined exact head.

options.title: Pause this stack
options.body: Keep the PR open without integration until approval-stack owners choose the contract and landing boundary.

recommendation.title: Split unique remainder
recommendation.body: Create narrow current-main PRs for ancestor-session replay and fail-closed authorization while dropping duplicated mobile and generated gate churn.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the aggregate and its merged stack segments and is best positioned to choose whether to split or rebuild the landing vehicle.
